positions.title: Software Developer / IT Technician Backup
positions.description: Continue to support and maintain software create in the internship. Provide desktop support, printing assistance, computer infrastructure upgrade. Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: Developed an application that generated new drawing files names according to a new naming convention and renames those files which are integrated into a SolidWorks PDM Vault requiring to use APIs, and integrates these drawing files into the ERP system (Sage b7). It also checks every 15 minutes for new drawings revision and sends automatically emails 3 times per mouth containing a resume of drawings files that are out of naming contention, in incorrect folder structures and out of file name length limit.

positions.title: Software Developer / IT Technician Backup / Production Supervisor Helper
positions.description: Developed and maintain internal software applications that streamline product manufacturing, data collection and presentation. Worked as a backup for the main IT Technician. Worked close to production supervisor to ensure shipment on time to the customer.
